**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/20 (Sat) 10:44
- [USER] User requested an HTML module for displaying a post, including an image, a list of categories, a description, an author name, and a link.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided an example of an HTML module for displaying a post with the following structure:
  ```
  <div class="post">
    <img src="image-url" alt="Post Image">
    <ul class="categories">
      <li>Category 1</li>
      <li>Category 2</li>
      <li>Category 3</li>
    </ul>
    <p class="description">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed auctor, magna a faucibus condimentum, ipsum velit congue augue, vel auctor velit velit a quam.</p>
    <p class="author">Author: John Doe</p>
    <a href="link-url">Read More</a>
  </div>
  ```
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained the structure of the module, mentioning that it uses a div with a class of "post" to contain all elements and that it can be modified as per user requirements.
